page_title: AUG 1-1 DOR | Augsburg v Dortmund 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+5' Finn Dahmen makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) on the edge of the box and he drills goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the goal.
90+4' Robert Gumny (Augsburg) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+3' Dion Beljo (Augsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

90+2' Dion Beljo plays a lovely pass into Ruben Vargas (Augsburg), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
90+1' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Sebastien Haller (Dortmund).
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' A substitution has been made. Elvis Rexhbecaj is replaced by Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg).
90' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Patric Pfeiffer (Augsburg) replacing Kevin Mbabu.
89' Substitution. Emre Can makes way for Sebastien Haller (Dortmund).
88' A pass into the box finds Donyell Malen (Dortmund) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Finn Dahmen denies him.

88' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) fails to beat the keeper from a good chance. He received a nice lofted pass inside the box and shot low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper deflected the ball onto the post with a quick reaction save and maybe some luck.
87' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Finn Dahmen.
85' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

85' A lofted cross from Samuel Bamba (Dortmund) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee blows his whistle, Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
83' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gregor Kobel intercepts the ball.
82' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) can bury his head in the sand! He misses the rebound from the edge of the box as he plants a header well wide of the right post! A typical school boy error!

80' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
80' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Matthias Jollenbeck didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
79' It seemed like Julian Brandt (Dortmund) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
79' Matthias Jollenbeck couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) and blew his whistle. Dortmund have a free kick from a promising distance.
78' It will be a substitution. Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Ermedin Demirovic walks off.
78' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Finn Dahmen makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
77' Jess Thorup has decided to substitute Phillip Tietz and he is replaced by Dion Beljo (Augsburg).

74' Samuel Bamba (Dortmund) hides his face in shame! He misses the rebound from the edge of the box as he plants a header miles wide of the left post! A typical school boy error! The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
71' Edin Terzic prepares a substitution. Jamie Bynoe-Gittens is replaced by Samuel Bamba (Dortmund).

70' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
69' Substitution. Arne Engels leaves the pitch and is replaced by Robert Gumny (Augsburg).
68' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) works the corner short.
67' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
64' The resulting set piece from Dortmund is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
59' Dortmund take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) comes onto the pitch for Marco Reus.

55' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
55' Augsburg have a corner.

55' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the roof of the net. Gregor Kobel guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

53' Mads Pedersen picks out Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) with a lofted pass into the centre of the box, but his header rises just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
52' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
50' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Gregor Kobel is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
45+2' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45+1' Dortmund can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

45' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

44' Dortmund are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
42' Thomas Meunier (Dortmund) commits a rough foul. Matthias Jollenbeck stops the game and makes a call.
38' The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.

35' 1 - 1 Goal! Great link up play between Donyell Malen (Dortmund) and Niclas Fullkrug gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 1:1.
35' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
32' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
26' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Augsburg players have a reason to celebrate!
25' The Augsburg players halt their celebrations as referee Matthias Jollenbeck makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
23' 1 - 0 Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Gregor Kobel with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
21' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

19' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
18' The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Dortmund, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Matthias Jollenbeck has a clear sight and sees a foul from Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg). It's a free kick to Dortmund, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
12' Arne Engels (Augsburg) gets a shot in from close range, but it's unluckily blocked by one of his teammates.
11' The ball is cleared after Donyell Malen (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

9' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
9' Dortmund quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

8' Marco Reus (Dortmund) gets inside the box and tries to beat Finn Dahmen with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Dortmund force a corner. They send men into the box.
8' Gregor Kobel displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
5' A pass by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
4' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
3' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Dortmund will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Matthias Jollenbeck.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
